content.title: Vista Energy Says Milei Reforms Could Help Boost Output
content.description: Vista Energy SAB, a top driller in Argentina's shale patch, says reforms from President Javier Milei could help fuel growth and double its oil output by 2030. Vista Chairman & CEO Miguel Galuccio says having "less tax" and "more flexibility" will help the company be more competitive. He speaks on "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily."
